items.name: SWISSAIR
items.image_alt: Monochrome museum portrait of a grounded four-engine Swiss passenger jet before an Alpine horizon
items.epitaph: The flying bank became the airline whose grounded fleet shocked a nation.
items.why: An expensive acquisition strategy, heavy losses, and a liquidity crisis brought the airline down.
items.afterlife: Aircraft, uniforms, posters, archives, and successor Swiss preserve the identity of the national carrier.
items.source_name: Swiss National Museum and Swiss Federal Archives
items.note: Swissair was founded in 1931 and grounded in October 2001; limited flights and the legal transition continued, so the endpoint is marked uncertain.
